label: Section 17 - Widows, minors whose fathers are deceased, and persons over 70 - $2,000 in valuation or a tax of $175, whichever is greater.
Section 22 - Disabled or wounded veterans, or their wives, widows or parents - $2,000 to $10,000 or a tax from $175 to $875, whichever is greater depending on degree of disability.
Section 22E - Veterans with yearly certificate from Veterans' Administration indicating 100%disability.
Section 37 - Blind persons - $5,000 valuation or a tax of $437.50, whichever is greater.
Section 41 - Persons aged 70 or over - $4,000 valuation or a tax of $350, whichever is greater.

Section 41A - Tax deferral for certain persons 65 years of age or over with gross receipts of under $20,000 annually to place the taxes on his domicile and one acre of land on a deferred payment plan,
Section 42 - Unmarried widows of police officers or firefighters killed in the line of duty - $8,000 valuation, or a tax of $700, whichever is greater.
Section 43 - Minor orphans of police officers or firefighters killed in the line of duty - $8,000 in valu- ation, or a tax of $700, whichever is greater.
Clause 61A Section 9 - Provides for assessment of agricultural or horticultural land at value based upon its agri- cultural or horticultural use.
